definitions.gloss: to carry around, to take with oneself
definitions.explanation: To carry something while moving from place to place.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I always carry my smartphone with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a habit of carrying an umbrella around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's dangerous to carry a lot of cash around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く⟦ようにしている→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: When traveling abroad, I make sure to always carry my passport with me.

notes:
{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く means to carry something around with you as you go about your daily activities.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) + ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk). The combination emphasizes carrying something habitually or while moving from place to place.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes を particle: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く

ASPECT (ている):
{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている indicates a habitual practice of carrying something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to always carry around
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry cash
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry an umbrella
- ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry a passport

RELATED: ⟦{携帯|けいたい}する→携帯する：21144_keitaisuru⟧ is a more formal synonym meaning "to carry/bring along."
